intent: PSI-030: Deploy Migration M3 role and group mail schema and pgTAP tests.
summary: Applied migration M3 (20260926023837_role_and_group_mail.sql) creating messages and message_recipients tables with role XOR group check constraint, security definer cycle-breaking helpers is_message_sender and is_message_recipient, service-role-only mail_recipients function with group inheritance resolution, and public mail_recipient_count function. Added pgTAP tests in supabase/tests/role_mail.test.sql.

decisions.decision: No email columns in messages or message_recipients tables
decisions.reason: Follows privacy architecture: email addresses are resolved strictly on-demand by service-role send-role-mail function.

decisions.decision: Use security definer helper functions to break RLS recursion
decisions.reason: Avoids infinite recursion errors when messages and message_recipients policies reference each other.

verification.manual: Verified pgTAP test suite with 30 assertions passing cleanly.

human_review.reason: Awaiting human operator review stamp on PSI-030 card.
